errors.text_span: starts at approximately 77.8% accuracy at 0 shots, increases to around 78.2% at 3 shots, reaches about 78.3% at 5 shots
errors.evidence: The reported values for the LLaMA 8B model are consistently overestimated. The plot shows values of approximately 77.5% at 0 shots, 77.9% at 3 shots, and 78.0% at 5 shots, whereas the description gives 77.8%, 78.2%, and 78.3% respectively.

This phrasing implies that the LLaMA 8B data series continues beyond 5 shots. However, the plot clearly shows that the data for this model ends at the 5-shot mark. The description should have stated that no further data points were visible, as it correctly does for the ChatGPT model.
The description claims the y-axis spans from 78% to 85%, but the visible axis ticks and data points extend below 78%. The lowest data point for LLaMA 8B is at approximately 77.5%.
The y-axis range shown is from just below 78% to just above 85%, and includes data points below 78% (e.g., LLaMA 8B starts at 77.5%). The description incorrectly states the range starts at 78%.
The starting point for the LLaMA 8B line at 0 shots is at 77.5%, not 77.8%. The data point is exactly halfway between the 77 and 78 gridlines.
The data point for LLaMA 8B at 3 shots is approximately 77.9%, which is visibly below the 78% gridline. 78.1% would be above the line.

errors.text_span: plateauing at about 78% from 5 to 10 shots
errors.evidence: The LLaMA 8B line does not plateau. It reaches 78.0% at 5 shots and then decreases to approximately 77.9% at 10 shots. Describing it as plateauing at 78% is incorrect for both the trend and the final value.
The data point for Qwen2 at 3 shots is approximately 78.4%, slightly below its starting point of 78.5%. The stated value of 78.3% is an inaccurate reading.
